fields.name: Desc_
fields.description: {"value":"TrafficFree: Cycle route closed to public motor vehicles such as a footway, cycle path or bridleway; \nOnroad : Cycle route open to and used by public motor vehicles","fieldValueType":"description"}

fields.name: Greenway
fields.alias: Does this route run along a greenway?
fields.description: {"value":"This field only applies to traffic-free sections. A greenway is a linear path, often along a natural corridor.","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: RouteType
fields.description: {"value":"NCN (National Cycle Network): Cycle route is signed by a number in a red box.   \nRCN (Regional Cycle Network – network not maintained/updated by Sustrans): Cycle route is signed by a number in a blue box\nLink (connects to NCN, but not part of a route): Cycle route is signed by a number enclosed in brackets (blue or red box).","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: RouteNo
fields.description: {"value":"This is the route number for the NCN or RCN","fieldValueType":"nameOrTitle"}

fields.name: LinkNo
fields.description: {"value":"Link numbers show which NCN or RCN the link joins with. They are displayed in brackets on real-world signs.","fieldValueType":"nameOrTitle"}

fields.name: RouteCat
fields.description: {"value":"This shows the route category for each feature. Most will be main routes, but occasionally alternative routes will be captured. This field also shows temporary diversions.","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: OpenStatus
fields.description: {"value":"A feature will either be open or have a temporary closure. ","fieldValueType":"description"}

fields.name: Surface
fields.description: {"value":"This field describes the surface/ground conditions of this feature on the National Cycle Network. Surfaces range from asphalt, concrete, blocks and slabs, to bare earth, cobbles and rocky surfaces. Smoother surfaces are more often found on on-road sections.","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: Quality
fields.description: {"value":"Smooth: Top quality asphalt, newly laid path, motorway standard; Standard: Average quality asphalt; Acceptable: Rough British country road or good quality unsealed surface; Rough: Would not normally be ridden on a road bike; MTB Only: A road bike definitely would not be a sensible vehicle for using this section (whether or not it is theoretically possible to cycle on this with enough skill).","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: Lighting
fields.alias: Does the route/feature have good lighting?
fields.description: {"value":"FullLit: Route link is fully lit, no dark patches.\nPartLit: Route is part lit, a few dark patches.\nNotLit: Route is not lit.","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: GlobalID
fields.alias: GlobalID - an internal field within ArcGIS Online
fields.description: {"value":"This is a unique identifier for each feature within the dataset. It is an internal field populated by ArcGIS Online","fieldValueType":"uniqueIdentifier"}
